scope: 3 fixed initial states x 5 controller variants; exploratory CPU diagnosis, not success-rate estimation
release_heading_sampling: first 50 Hz state >= last active robot-ball contact + 0.04 s
planned_line_distance: 2D infinite planned ray to initial pin centres; geometric diagnostic, not contact ground truth
held_constant: sampled push speed, height, duration, gripper, prepush distance

center_aim: push angle aims at head centre; original yaw noise retained
